observationsNotFindings: CARRIED FORWARD, THIRD CYCLE - D-121 RECORDING-KIND LABEL. OBL-AL3-CORE-ROLLBACK.reason still says self-update-repair-contract.v3 'is recorded at D-121 as DR-110 leftover T2-02'. I re-verified at this HEAD: D-121's heading reads 'accepted design-contract successor candidate' and its body contains zero occurrences of 'T2-02' or 'leftover', whereas D-122's heading does use the leftover-T2-02 label. The locus D-121 is right and the label is defensible against the recorded artifact's own bytes - self-update-repair-contract.v3's authorityClaim reads 'This artifact PROPOSES the DR-110 leftover T2-02 extraction' and its purpose names the generation-rollback versus self-update-rollback boundary the subject cites - but it is not the kind label D-121 itself used. Still not a finding: the obligation stays leftoverDesign true, the clause is used only to refuse coverage, and the error runs conservative. COORDINATOR NOTE: this sentence was touched in this successor for speaker-naming, so the label survived an edit pass; it is worth correcting the next time this obligation is substantively in scope.

BARE VERSION TOKEN, NO COLLISION. OBL-AL3-CORE-ROLLBACK.reason ends 'anti-lockstep leftover-join.v4 does not apply v3 and does not claim v3 covers AL-3 core-release-byte rollback', where the antecedent is self-update-repair-contract.v3 named in the immediately preceding sentence. The corpus bar established by CLAUDE-ALHG-V2-M-1 is a bare version token that collides with the speaker's own version; the speaker here is v4, so no collision arises, and proposedLaterWork[2] states the same refusal with the full artifact name. Not a finding; a full name in both clauses would still read better.

DISCLAIMER PLACEMENT ASYMMETRY. The custody disclaimer 'Not this artifact's version number' is applied to predecessorV3, hostileGoldensV3, g21JoinV14, g21v3, g16v2, predecessorV1 and predecessorV2, but omitted on occupancyG21V4 - the single cited artifact whose version token equals the speaker's own. No ambiguity results, because every live mention of that token is qualified as 'Occupancy v4' or 'occupancy remasurement v4', and the same role sentence names the speaker in full. Not a finding; the predecessor applied the disclaimer only to its own lineage, so this successor broadened rather than narrowed the discipline.

SUMMARY FLAG SCOPE. summary.goldensAuthored is false while the subject asserts in six places that D-300 authored sixteen citation implementations. Read in context the flag is speaker-scoped, sitting beside newRowProposed, fixturesExecuted, d096Minted and classAOpened, all of which are acts of the speaker - anti-lockstep-hostile-goldens.v3 sets the same convention and records its own authoring as authoredMembers 16 rather than as a goldensAuthored flag. The authored-sixteen fact is carried structurally in obligations[1].authoredImplementations, which is the authoritative ledger. Not a finding; a summary-level counterpart field would make the roll-up self-sufficient.

OBL-CC-EXECUTION.reason renders D-015 as 'DR-127 gains no design-level SATISFIED supplier from CC-1..CC-11 existing' where COORD's readiness effect reads 'DR-127 gains no design-level supplier from CC-1..CC-11 - the classes are specifications, not executed evidence', in a bullet whose first clause is 'condition 2 gains zero SATISFIED rows'. The inserted word is context-preserving, the rendering is unquoted, and it narrows rather than widens the claim. Not a finding.
